item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_meatballs.too: Served warm, with lingonberry on the side.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_lingonberry_j: A small jar of lingonberry jam.
message.scp_unleashed.scp3008.no_sleep.0: You close your eyes. Somewhere far off, a trolley rolls past.
message.scp_unleashed.scp3008.no_sleep.1: The mattress still smells of new fabric. Sleep will not come here.
message.scp_unleashed.scp3008.no_sleep.2: It is too quiet to sleep. Far too quiet.
message.scp_unleashed.scp3008.counter.se: A warm plate slides across the counter.
message.scp_unleashed.scp3008.counter.em: The warming trays are empty for now.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp3008.place.ove: The SCP-3008 store can only be placed in the Overworld.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp3008.place.aim: Look at the ground where the store should stand.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp3008.place.suc: Placed the SCP-3008 store; its entrance is at %s, %s, %s.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp3008.not_insid: You must be inside SCP-3008 to do that.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp3008.time: The SCP-3008 clock now reads hour %s.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp3008.0: A large retail building reported in open country.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp3008.away: Return to the overworld to trace it.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp3008.1: A huge blue and yellow store.
archive.scp_unleashed.lead.scp3008_trace: A survey has traced a large retail building nearby.
archive.scp_unleashed.lead.scp3008_near: A huge blue building rises over the horizon.
Glass doors from a very large store. Walking through them is easy.
Nobody has come back out through them.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_floor.1: Polished concrete from a store floor. No tool has ever marked it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_pillar.1: A store pillar. It rises further than anyone can see.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_ceiling.1: A ceiling panel. Nobody is sure how it was reached.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_exit_door: A plain door marked EXIT. Doors like this one are hard to come by.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_emergency: A green emergency light. It keeps glowing when everything else goes dark.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_food_coun: A food court counter. Nobody stands behind it, yet warm plates keep turning up.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_crate.1: A flat-pack box from the store shelves. Some still hold stock.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_meatballs: Warm meatballs from a food court counter.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_departmen: A hanging department sign. The names do not match any company on record.
jade.scp_unleashed.scp3008_entrance: The doors slide open for anyone.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.title: A Perfectly Normal, Regular Old IKEA
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.caption: SCP-3008 seen from the edge of its parking area.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.0.text.0: The building housing SCP-3008 cannot be damaged, locked or moved. Its entrance is to be watched from the parking area at all times.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.0.text.1: Entry is permitted only for approved exploration teams. **Teams are to carry food, a light source and the means to build shelter.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.0.text.2: Personnel who return are to be debriefed at once. %rNo team has ever returned through the doors it entered by.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.1.text.0: SCP-3008 is a large blue and yellow furniture store with a plain front and no owner on record. Anyone who walks through its main entrance arrives in SCP-3008-1, usually without noticing the change.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.1.text.1: SCP-3008-1 resembles the inside of the same store, extended without limit. Polished floors, marked walkways and showroom displays continue in every direction. Pillars rise past the point where anything can be seen. The ceiling has never been reached.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.1.text.2: The space is divided into departments, each stocked with its own goods. Food courts appear at irregular intervals, and their counters are never found empty for long.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.1.text.3: The overhead lighting keeps its own hours. When it switches off, it does so all at once, and soft music that plays throughout the day stops with it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.1.text.4: SCP-3008-2 are humanoid figures in staff uniforms, with no faces and badly wrong proportions. During lit hours they wander and ignore visitors. %rOnce the lights go out they do not.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.2.title: Addendum 3008-1: Exploration I
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.2.text.0: A team of three entered with three days of supplies. They reported music from no visible speaker and a price tag on every display. On the second day the lights went out across the whole store in seconds.
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.2.text.1: Contact resumed at what the team called morning. **Two members were recovered.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.3.title: Addendum 3008-2: Recovered Note
dossier.scp_unleashed.3008.page.3.text: Found folded inside a flat-pack box carried out by a returning visitor: "Build walls before dark. Do not follow the music. If you ever see a door that says EXIT, go through it and do not look back."
message.scp_unleashed.scp3008_staff.clos: The store is now closed. Please leave the building.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_staff_spa: SCP-3008-2: the faceless staff of SCP-3008. They wear the store uniform, yellow shirts and blank name badges, but nothing under it is the right shape.
No two are built alike. Some are short and heavy, some tall with arms that hang past their knees, and every one of them has far too many knuckles.
During store hours they keep to their work. They tidy the shelves, stand at their posts and watch the customers. They do not like being pushed around.
When the lights go out, the store is closed.
They are only ever found inside the store.
item.scp_unleashed.crowbar.tooltip: Heavy enough to pry most things loose.
item.scp_unleashed.crowbar.details: Use it on a piece of furniture to lift it whole. Use again to set it down, or sneak and use to turn it first.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_table_leg_spe: Keeps trouble at arm's length. It throws well, too.
message.scp_unleashed.scp3008_gear_too_b: It is too big to lift.
message.scp_unleashed.scp3008_gear_no_ro: There is no room to set it down.
Two seats, deep cushions, no assembly instructions.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_living_armch: A good chair to wait in.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_living_coffe: Wipe-clean top. Someone has already left a ring on it.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_living_side_: Just big enough for a plant and a book you will not finish.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_living_tv_be: The display screen has never been switched on.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_living_bookc: Filled with sample books. Every page is blank.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_living_cube_: Four cubes. The storage boxes are sold separately, yet here they are.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_living_rug.t: Short pile, hard-wearing, a little too cheerful.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_dining_chair: Stackable, if you ever find a second one that matches.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_dining_bench: Fits more people than you would expect.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_dining_stool: Light enough to carry a long way.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_dining_displ: Glass door. Please do not tap the glass.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_kitchen_base: Soft-closing door. The hinge hardware comes in twice.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_kitchen_wall: Hangs on any wall. The nearest wall may be some distance away.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_kitchen_sink: The tap is plumbed into something.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_kitchen_frid: The light inside stays on. Probably.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_kitchen_isla: Butcher block top, solid enough to stand on.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_kitchen_cart: Three trays, four wheels, no brakes.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_kitchen_wall: Utensils included. Nobody remembers ordering them.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bedroom_doub: Generous width, display model, not for sleeping.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bedroom_sing: Cosy single frame with a striped duvet. Assembly instructions missing.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bedroom_ward: Two doors, one hanging rail, endless storage options.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bedroom_ches: Three smooth-running drawers under an oak top.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bedroom_nigh: One drawer, one shelf, one ticking clock.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bedroom_floo: Tilts to show you at your best angle.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bedroom_clot: Steel rail with a shoe shelf. Clothes sold separately.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bathroom_van: Ceramic basin over a two-door cabinet. The tap still runs.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bathroom_toi: Dual flush. Please do not test it in the showroom.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bathroom_bat: Deep enough to soak in. Plug included.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bathroom_sho: Hinged glass door and a wide rain head.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bathroom_tow: Leans on any wall. Display towels included.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bathroom_mir: Mirrored door with two shelves behind it.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_bathroom_lau: A woven lid keeps the mess out of sight.
A clean white top on steel trestle legs.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_office_filin: Three drawers for everything you meant to file.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_office_shelv: Open steel shelving for binders and boxes.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_office_desk_: Adjustable arm and a warm yellow shade.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_office_white: Someone left a meeting on it.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_children_bun: Display model. Please do not sleep in the store.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_children_toy: Tidy every toy away in seconds. The lid closes softly.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_children_cha: Sturdy enough for little ones, and for you.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_children_roc: Hand-finished birch. Rocks gently, never tips.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_children_pla: Everything a small chef needs, except the heat.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_lighting_pen: Rice paper shade for a soft, even glow.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_lighting_flo: Three legs, one shade, warm reading light.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_lighting_lam: Five lamps on one wall. Ask staff about stock levels.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_textiles_rug: Woven rugs, rolled up for easy carrying.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_textiles_cur: Feel the fabric, then imagine it at home.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_outdoor_gard: Oiled hardwood. Leave it out all summer.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_outdoor_para: Shade for a sun that never shows.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_warehouse_ai: Note your aisle and location before you leave.
tooltip.scp_unleashed.scp3008_furnc.lamp: Use to switch on or off
tooltip.scp_unleashed.scp3008_furnc.aisl: Use to change the number, sneak to go back
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_particleboard: Pressed wood chips with a birch-look face. Pre-drilled, as always.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_steel_tube.to: A powder-coated furniture tube. Hollow, but it holds.
Cam locks, dowels and screws. There is always one left over.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_fabric_scraps: Upholstery offcuts in this season's colours.
Springy cushion foam. It still smells new.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_cardboard.too: Flattened packaging. The store never runs out of it.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_acrylic_sheet: A clear panel that bends before it breaks.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_led_bulb.tool: Warm white. Rated for twenty thousand hours.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_battery.toolt: Still in date, according to the packet.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_allen_key.too: Comes with everything. You get to keep it.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_crispbread.to: Dry, crunchy and good for years.
Pearl sugar on top. Slightly squashed.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_canned_herrin: Pickled herring in a ring-pull tin.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_chocolate_bar: Dark chocolate. Good for tired legs.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_cold_brew.too: Strong, cold and bitter. Work goes quicker for a while.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_first_aid_kit: Plasters, gauze and a foil blanket. Everything a long shopping trip needs.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_claw_hammer.t: Takes furniture apart much faster than it went together.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_colander_helm: Worn upside down. Ventilated, stainless and surprisingly protective.
Seat cushions stitched onto a canvas bib. The price tag is still on.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_cardboard_gre: Flat-pack box board, folded and taped round the shins.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_felt_slippers: Fuzzy felt house slippers. Warm, quiet and one size fits most.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_battery_lant: A camping lantern from the lighting aisle.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_flatpack_wor: Assembled without instructions. It works as a crafting table.
block.scp_unleashed.scp3008_battery_lant: Use it to switch it on or off. It drains while lit. Use a battery on it to fit a fresh one.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_particleb: Salvaged from wooden furniture: tables, shelves, cabinets and beds. Warehouse stock is full of it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_steel_tub: Salvaged from metal furniture: rails, trolleys, office chairs, lamps and store racking.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_hex_fitti: Comes out of almost every piece of furniture you take apart.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_fabric_sc: Salvaged from sofas, beds, rugs and the textile aisles. Staff uniforms tear, too.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_foam_fill: Salvaged from sofas, armchairs, beds, office chairs and cushion bins.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_cardboard: Salvaged from flat-pack stacks, pallets, bookcases and office filing. Most stockrooms have some.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_acrylic_s: Salvaged from glass-fronted cabinets, mirrors, showers, bathtubs and lamps.
Sometimes left inside lamps and fridges. The lighting department keeps spares.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_battery.1: Found in drawers and stockrooms, most often in the office, lighting and children's departments.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_allen_key: Packed with flat-pack furniture and left in store drawers. Assembly needs one, and it is never used up.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_flatpack_: A full crafting grid. The bigger store recipes need one.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_flatpack_scre: Every cam lock in the store comes undone for it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp3008_flatpack_: Break store furniture with it and the whole piece packs flat into one item, ready to carry anywhere and build again. Anything stored inside spills out. The store's own floors, pillars and doors stay put.
item.scp_unleashed.scp3008_flatpack_scre: Break a piece of store furniture with it to pack the whole piece flat instead of salvaging it. Anything stored inside spills out.
tooltip.scp_unleashed.scp3008_econ_store: Full store set: staff take longer to notice you.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp3008.regen.bus: A store rebuild is already running; wait for it to finish.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp3008.regen.che: Checking %s loaded store chunks around you (%s more are not loaded)...
commands.scp_unleashed.scp3008.regen.reb: Rebuilding %s loaded store chunks around you (%s more are not loaded)...
commands.scp_unleashed.scp3008.regen.pre: %s chunks checked: %s blocks differ from the generated store, %s of them are not part of it (your builds or leftovers from older versions), and %s staff would be sent away. Run /scp_unleashed scp3008 regen %s confirm to rebuild.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp3008.regen.don: Rebuilt %s chunks: %s blocks restored, %s removed and %s staff sent away.
